confirm.title: Add UpDown Desk
confirm.description:
Set up {name} ({address})?

Home Assistant will connect and read the desk's calibration to confirm it is a supported controller. Close the phone app first: the desk accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time.

user.title: Add UpDown Desk
user.description: Choose your desk controller. Close the phone app first: the desk accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time.

manual.title: Add UpDown Desk
manual.description: No desk controller was discovered. Enter its Bluetooth address by hand.

error.cannot_connect: Could not talk to the desk. Make sure the phone app is closed and the desk is powered, then try again.
error.not_found: The desk is not in range of any Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.unsupported_model: The desk replied, but reported a controller model this integration does not know how to convert to centimetres. Please open an issue with the model index from the logs.

abort.already_configured: This desk is already set up.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to ask the desk for its height in the background.
data_description.keep_connected: Hold the Bluetooth link open. The desk allows only one connection, so this blocks the phone app. Turn it off to connect only when a command is sent.
data_description.follow_handshake: Answer the desk's idle handshake with a height query, so handset movements show up straight away. This keeps the desk's LED display awake.
data_description.quiet_start: Background polling and height tracking are suspended during quiet hours, so the desk's display stays dark overnight. Leave both times empty to disable.
data_description.move_timeout: Give up and stop the desk if a move takes longer than this.

jog.name: Jog
jog.description: Hold the desk's up or down motor for a short time, then stop. Useful for fine adjustments.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold the motor, in seconds. Capped at 3 seconds.
